reserveReview.rationale: Issuer API source 2026-10-07T08:00:19.096Z, accessed 2026-10-07T20:47:18.580729Z, reports $15,537,989.483383574 reserves and 15,275,117.334802557 USDO with a 101.7209% ratio. Positive constituents normalize to TBILL 78.95194721%, BUIDL 9.64028307%, RLUSD 8.62380556%, VBILL 2.63169331%, and USDC 0.15227084%. USYC, BENJI, pending-USDC and uAmount are observed zero and create no positive holdings. The ratio reconciles only reported usdoAmount, not every queued claim; pendingReserverAssetsRedeem and gap fields are unresolved context, not additional inventory. This is issuer accounting, not independent financial assurance or proof of redemption openness.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: OpenEden states that USDO reserve assets and liabilities are held in a segregated account of a Bermuda segregated-accounts company and are insulated from claims against other accounts. The current reserve API identifies asset holdings but not the account-level custodians, provider shares, underlying fund custody chains, or rehypothecation terms.
